children: Reliance Industries reported Q2 FY27 profit of ₹29,550 crore, up 33.8% year over year, and revenue of ₹3,62,268 crore, up 27.8%. EBITDA rose 23.9% to a record ₹62,409 crore.
Jio Platforms’ 28 October listing gave investors direct access to its telecom and digital business. Reliance Industries’ holding-company discount narrowed from about 30% to 20–25%.
Reliance plans to start coal gasification exploration in Andhra Pradesh in January, then move to Recherla. It targets a pilot by mid-2028, with up to ₹3,000 crore earmarked.
